reviews.text: Well-located clinic with excellent professionals providing specialized care.
I really like the WeVets Mooca unit; I take my cats there regularly for exams and consultations, and I've always received excellent care and a warm welcome from the staff!
Excellent reception and service. An organized and clean place!

Dr. Rafaela was attentive from beginning to end with my cat!! An incredible person, caring, attentive, and who certainly loves what she does. I left there feeling that my baby received the attention he needed to recover!

I received excellent care from the moment my kitten was admitted until the day he was discharged. The veterinarians were always very helpful with my questions and I found them to be well-prepared in all aspects of their treatment! I recommend them without hesitation.
Excellent service. I took my puppy to get vaccinated and received great care. Very pleasant environment and high quality.

Excellent service, good facilities.
My pet has their plan and it's very good. I recommend it.
Excellent service, very attentive and caring professionals.
I've always received excellent service; I've been taking my dogs there for a while and I'm satisfied with the service.

I've been taking my two dogs to WeVets Mooca for some time now, and how lucky we are, and they are, to have come across such competent, intelligent, and caring professionals as those who work there.

Dr. Matheus Spironelli ends up taking care of them most of the time, and once again, I emphasize that it's an immense blessing and joy to have such a highly qualified professional who treats animals in a unique way from the very first contact with them.

Matheus takes care of my 15-year-old dog and my 3-year-old dog, and he insists that the care and all procedures performed on both are the best for each of them. He always answers my many questions and makes it very clear why each procedure, medication, and indication is necessary... The procedures are always very clear and prioritize what's best for the pets.

My older dog also needed emergency surgery, and we relied on the help of other professionals who did everything to save him (and they succeeded!). They took excellent care of him throughout his hospitalization and the entire post-operative period. My deepest gratitude to each of them for taking such good care of Mr. Safado. <3 It made a huge difference for him and for me, as his owner.

In short, after many paragraphs, the WeVets plan is well worth it because of the excellent professionals who care for our pets. I recommend the Mooca unit without hesitation.

My dog ​​has a tumor in a delicate location, and to perform the CT scan, she needed to have a general blood test and a specific test that requires 2 samples taken 1 hour apart. We have the Wevets health plan, which honestly is costing me more than it's providing.
On August 15, 2026, I went to Wevets Mooca to have blood drawn early in the morning, and everything went well. However, when I returned to have the 2 specific blood drawn later in the morning, there was a different employee there. She tried to draw blood from the neck and couldn't, she kept the needle in the dog's neck for a long time, and I was starting to get anxious, until the dog started screaming and shaking her head to get out of there (this has never happened before; she is super calm during all blood draws throughout her life). I asked if they wanted to try collecting blood from her paw, and it was the same result... needle in the paw, delay, moving the needle around the dog's body, and nothing, not a single drop of blood came out, until she started screaming again and I canceled everything. The employee was not properly trained, and there was no one responsible with her who could help. She gave countless justifications for why she couldn't do it. I left and went to a private place I trust to have the blood drawn, and, obviously, they inserted the needle and in seconds managed to draw her blood without any stress, without any delay, and without any screaming.
It's no use having a plan if you have to resort to a private place to complete a simple blood draw.
Our dog was taken to the veterinary hospital, but unfortunately there was nothing that could be done; in short, there wasn't much we could do.

Dear Wevets!

I was informed of the plan category change; however, they added an extra word: they want to build loyalty, even though I never had the slightest intention of leaving the plan. They want to take away the rights we've acquired so far because of R$10.00!

It's absurd the lack of respect for the pet owner. They created an old category, changed it, and now want to reinstate the waiting period – how absurd!! All this just to avoid giving us the right to a Bravecto application that they advertised!

When I switched from Petlove, I got the second-best plan from Wevets, and now they want me to cancel it, then re-enroll to have a waiting period to regain rights. Where is that fair?

It's absurd and a terrible campaign that mocks the customer!

If you're not ready to serve, don't do it. If you don't want to prioritize those who have been with you longer, tell us to leave the plan, okay?

Just a reminder that to this day I have not received a response to my complaints about the terrible service at your surgical center and inpatient unit. Everything is resolved with a "we'll check and get back to you," remembering that the responsibility lies with the pet; it doesn't ask for help, but the owner needs information and to know that it is okay.

I am disappointed and frustrated with the lack of preparation and ability to deal with pet owners and care for pets at Wevets. You are growing without the capacity to manage, promote, and care for everyone who has been with you from the beginning.

Mooca Unit - Paes de Barros, for anyone who may be interested!

Lamentable!

Sincerely, Josy Santana

I scheduled a blood and urine test, but I couldn't find a urine test option on the app. To try and get an appointment, I went to the Mooca clinic. Upon arrival, the receptionist informed me that I would have to wait, that the blood sample would be taken first, followed by the urine sample by the ultrasound department. Yes, I waited from 8:30 AM until 10:30 AM for my scheduled appointment. To my surprise, they didn't include Bisteca for the urine test. Around 11:30 AM, the receptionist said that a simple collection with a small collection cup would be acceptable. I asked for the cup and collected the urine. The animal had been fasting for over 15 hours, a tremendous lack of respect for the animal.
Wonderful service!
The hospital is excellent; I take my children there whenever I need to.

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service and reception of the health plan. I contracted a pet plan for my 5 dogs and I am trying to take the best care of them I can. I had scheduled an x-ray through the app that should have cost around 38 reais, but at the clinic I was charged double because, firstly, it's per image. The day before, I tried to anticipate the waiting period, but it wasn't possible, only by credit card. They said it would eliminate the waiting period, but don't fall for it! You'll schedule it and you have to bring extra money because it won't be the amount offered in the plan; it's higher, it's double. Also, the doctor isn't obligated to specify how many images are needed on the order; the owner is supposed to guess with a crystal ball. The medical care is regular, but the plan's service and reception are terrible. I will post photos of everything I did to schedule and what it should cover. But at the time, you don't have access to what coverage is available. So if you think you're going to save money by paying for the plan, don't be fooled. If it's 50 reais on the app, you'll pay double or more at the clinic, and the receptionist who processes the order... She could have put in 6 images if she wanted, and I would have had a bill of over 200 reais just for an x-ray because there was a discount. Now there are popular pet labs that do it cheaper, so if I had gone privately at another time I would have paid almost the same.

I loved my consultation with Dr. Maria Fernanda at Onco Clínica and was delighted by her competence, attention, and professionalism!!! A top-notch professional!!!

The receptionists are also very attentive and pleasant!!!

Worst hospital in the WEVETS network, I am a client of the Wevets and Petlove health plans, and I have always received poor service at the Mooca unit. Today, July 21, 2026, I waited for 1 HOUR, and I saw several people who arrived after me being seen before me!

Prefer the Braz Leme unit; I have always received quick and respectful service at that location.

Lack of empathy in the post-care service from the inpatient team on duty on 07/20/26. I requested to speak with the person in charge and no one answered. Dr. Maria Luíza Abarca Santos CRMV SP 73540 wrote a new prescription and asked the receptionist to give it to me. Total disregard for the pet and its owner. The Wevets network should review the type of professionals it hires.

On July 17th, at 6:30 PM, I scheduled an emergency appointment and, due to traffic, ended up being late. Before arriving, I called the call center to report the situation and was instructed to go to the clinic, as they assured me I would still be seen.

Upon arrival, the experience was completely different. I was greeted by receptionists who were extremely unprepared to handle an emergency situation. The service was marked by ill will, poor communication, lack of empathy, expressions of disinterest, and no concern for offering an alternative or support. They simply told me that I would only be seen if there was a cancellation.

I understand that delays can impact the schedule and that there are rules to be followed. The problem wasn't that, but rather the way the situation was handled. There was a clear mismatch of information between the call center and the reception, and I was the one who ended up being harmed, as I was with a dog needing care and was already quite stressed.

The lack of a welcoming and efficient initial service was enough for me to immediately leave the clinic in search of another place. I will never return.

I chose this clinic because of the specialist's excellent reputation, but for someone seeking emergency care, my experience was extremely disappointing. Even before reaching the veterinarian, the ordeal with reception and triage was enormous. Unfortunately, a good specialist doesn't compensate for such disrespectful and unprepared initial service.

Terrible service from Dr. Lucas, from Dr. Fernando Ibanez's (orthopedist) team.

I paid R$300 for the consultation, which was scheduled to last 30 minutes, but lasted approximately 10 minutes. During that time, the professional was unable to adequately advise on my cat's case, who fell from the 6th floor and has a broken paw.

There was no clear position on the best treatment, whether surgery, physiotherapy, or another approach would be necessary. Furthermore, I was advised to return to the previous orthopedist I was already seeing.

I consider this a great disrespect, since if my intention was to continue with the previous professional, I would have scheduled directly with him, and not paid for a new consultation without guidance.

I expected more empathy, preparedness, and commitment in the face of such a delicate case.

If you love your pet, stay away.

I signed up for WeVets health insurance for all my cats believing I would have more security, especially during a difficult time. The result was exactly the opposite.

My cat Maru, who has kidney disease, was hospitalized for several days. During that time, I encountered a completely disorganized team. Each veterinarian said something different. At several points, I had the impression that one professional simply didn't know what the other had done.

We even questioned medications that left my cat extremely sedated, unable to even stand to eat. The response we received from one of the veterinarians herself was that she couldn't explain why those medications had been administered. If even the team can't justify their actions, how can the owner trust the treatment?

We also received contradictory messages daily. One day they said he would be discharged. The next, they said they would prolong the hospitalization. They constantly requested new tests, but without clearly explaining the treatment plan, the objectives, or what actually justified his continued hospitalization.

Furthermore, I identified extremely worrying charges, including a nephrology consultation that the nephrologist herself later admitted she hadn't performed.

The ward's structure also disappointed me. The kennels were so small that my cat had to sit inside his litter box because there was practically no space for him to settle down.

But the most absurd moment happened at discharge. After several days of hospitalization, I arrived expecting to speak with the medical team about his clinical progress, the tests, the medications, and the necessary care from then on. Instead, they simply put my cat in the reception area and handed him over. There was no discussion of the case, clinical closure, or even minimally appropriate guidance for a hospitalization of that magnitude.

I completely lost confidence in the hospital and transferred Maru to a specialized feline clinic. There he was re-evaluated and discharged just two days later.

After this whole experience, I cancelled all my animals' health insurance plans.

The Ombudsman contacted me, but the conversation consisted of a series of "we're very sorry." No technical explanation. No acknowledgment of the failures. No objective answers to the problems I reported. Just generic apologies and the information that "the case would be forwarded for analysis." The only concrete action taken was to refund a charge that should never have existed.

What struck me most wasn't an isolated error. It was the constant feeling of disorganization, lack of communication, and lack of transparency within an environment where these qualities should be indispensable.

When we're talking about an animal's life, trust is everything.

And that, unfortunately, WeVets completely lost.

Check the company's reputation on Reclame Aqui (Brazilian consumer complaint website), numerous unresolved issues.

You'll be next, unfortunately!
The service at reception leaves much to be desired; even with scheduled appointments, they don't keep to the time!!!
They don't answer calls.

Hi Sandra! 🐾

Thank you so much for the stars! It's a great joy to know that you trust our team to take care of your pet. Our greatest commitment is to guarantee their health and well-being with lots of love and professionalism.

You can always count on WeVets for whatever you need! It will be a pleasure to welcome you again. 💙
Wonderful experience! The entire reception and veterinary team provided excellent care and attention. I've been going there for two years with my cat and I highly recommend it! ☺️☺️
Excellent service! Cleanliness and great professionals.

It's a mess; they lose tests and charge for tests that weren't performed.
How can a cat in the hospital for 24 hours have 20 blood tests done?

Make an accessible and transparent plan.

There is no transparency in the use of the plan. The company only cares about money and more money; your pet is the last thing on their mind.
Terrible service for scheduling appointments or if you need help.

The attendants blame the doctor, saying she doesn't respond.

Feline specialist doctor

My cat Teco was seen by Dr. Juliana on her Sunday night shift.

She was very attentive and helped us.

Thank you.

They don't respect schedules! If you have little time, a tight schedule, and need a clinic that works, run away from this place! There's always a reason, usually the same (an emergency came in), for them to delay procedures by 1, even 2 hours! Lamentable! Second and last time here, same situation. They don't have the structure or enough staff to handle the demand.

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to Drs. Rafaela, Alana, Lara, and Sophia for the exceptional care they provided at WeVets. They all demonstrated a very high level of professionalism, technical knowledge, and, above all, genuine care for the animals and their owners.

In moments that naturally generate concern, the team was extremely attentive, empathetic, and confident in every decision made. The way they conduct their appointments, even under pressure, inspires confidence and shows how prepared and dedicated they are to what they do.

Their love for their profession and commitment to the well-being of their patients is evident. Having professionals like them makes all the difference and raises the hospital's quality standard.

Without a doubt, I recommend them wholeheartedly!
My pet and I received excellent care and were treated with affection by competent professionals.

My review will be based on my experience in both the ICU and Semi-intensive care units.
Unfortunately, things didn't go as planned, and I lost my most precious possession.
I would like to thank the entire ICU and Semi-intensive care team for everything they did for my Floki and for all the love they gave him during his stay.
We went through many complications during an acute renal episode, but the entire team was always able to explain everything that happened.
A special thank you to Doctors Stella, Sofia, Isabella, Rafaella, Erika Sayuri, Thais Aguiar, and Gabrieli, who cared for my baby with immense affection.
The procedures are not cheap, but I recommend them to those who can afford them and want to try to save their pet in some way.
Receptionist Julia, who works the night shift, is always very helpful and efficient.

I would like to register my profound indignation at the deplorable service at reception, specifically from the employee Vanessa. While I was being assisted by another person, she gratuitously interfered, being extremely rude, stupid, and arguing with me with utter disdain. To make matters worse, there was an amateurish error on the part of reception itself: I scheduled all the exams together, but one of them was forgotten. Vanessa herself had the audacity to say that 'I can't trust what they schedule'. If the team itself admits its own incompetence and lack of psychological preparedness to deal with the public, this person should not be in customer service!!
Excellent service from reception to consultation with professionals.

The hospital is very modern and has all types of services available. We liked the doctors and care so much that we opted for the health plan for 2 pets, with the most comprehensive coverage, which guarantees even more peace of mind when we need to take our beloved pets for treatment. We had two periods in 2025 when one of them needed to be hospitalized, and it was the first time we had experienced this. We were surprised that the inpatient team sends daily reports at the beginning and end of the day.

In general, the teams, from reception to doctors, are very helpful. Sometimes we have a problem or two with customer service via WhatsApp, but we don't dwell on it too much.

I take back everything I said before. They left my dog ​​unable to walk and completely unable to urinate. Even after seeking help, which they said would be available for any situation, they only send him home with me signing a liability waiver, but they don't even offer support on how many drops of medicine to administer. Prepare for a lawsuit for extreme negligence because my 13-year-old son will probably be euthanized for ONLY SUPPLYING THE FINANCES OF THIS TRASH PLACE!

Good afternoon.
I contacted the Mooca unit, I was assisted by phone, they have the referral to schedule my dog's exams, I started talking on Friday, they sent me the available exam times, I chose two times, Friday after 7 pm I didn't hear back, they sent me a message two days later, asking the same questions, if I plan for the times I requested, 3 pm or 3:40 pm, they call me back on Sunday, with the times 4:20 pm and 5:40 pm, the only available times, this is a rip-off, honestly, terrible service.
Excellent service and very good...

I will take the necessary steps to seek compensation for damages.

Another issue is that I requested the invoices, and they haven't issued them yet.

Attentive service, clean and organized place.
Excellent service, great professionals, I recommend them!

The veterinary care provided by the veterinarians is very good. We have always received excellent service, with attentive, technically skilled, and careful professionals for my dog. In that respect, we have no complaints.

However, the management of the health plan leaves much to be desired. I have a strong impression that WeVets does not act with the expected transparency when it comes to the use of the plan.

I contracted the Super plan on November 8, 2025, which guarantees 20 annual exams. Since then, I have had 14 visits, many of which were just consultations, without exams. Even so, I was informed that the exam limit had been reached and they began to deny coverage for the co-payment.

My dog ​​is undergoing cancer treatment and needs frequent monitoring. At such a sensitive time, it is frustrating to face a lack of clarity in the accounting of exams and resistance to fulfilling what is stipulated in the contract.

I do not question the quality of the veterinarians, but rather the administrative approach to the plans. The minimum expected is transparency, a detailed report of usage, and fair compliance with the signed contract.
The best in São Paulo

My family and I have no words to thank the WeVets team for everything they did for our beloved Zé. There were days of hospitalization, surgery, and care. The team was dedicated and loving towards him and our family. They were empathetic, clear in their information, and spared no effort in caring for him. From reception to doctors and nurses, everything was impeccable. The ending isn't always happy, but when you're certain that everything is done with dedication, professionalism, and love – all you can do is thank and praise them.

The service from the professionals is excellent, they are super helpful and attentive, nothing to complain about. However, the payment system is HORRIBLE! In many cases, the client themselves enters the payment details into the system. But we complained about this, and we're left in limbo without a response.
Very attentive professionals!
My dog ​​lost an eye due to an accident. The entire team resolved the problem promptly and with great kindness and charisma, managing to calm me and my family down. I recommend them to everyone!!!!

Well-structured hospital.
I loved the service from the reception to the specialists.
Dr. Vanessa, the on-call clinician, was wonderful. Attentive in examining my pet and meticulous in investigating the tests. I highly recommend her.
Excellent service from both the reception and the veterinarians. Excellent hygiene and organization.

I would like to thank Dr. Matheus Gustavo Spironelli for the excellent care he provided to my dogs.
He is an extremely attentive, dedicated, and polite professional who cared for them with great affection and competence.
Professionals like Dr. Matheus raise the level of service at the place and undoubtedly deserve recognition for the work they do.

Today, December 26, 2025, I was at the Mooca unit and was seen by neurologist Dr. Thalita Michelucci. What an extraordinary professional! Attentive, welcoming, and extremely competent, she listened carefully to all the information reported and explained the possible diagnoses clearly and confidently. A unique professional who demonstrates technical excellence combined with humanized care.

May we have more and more professionals like Dr. Thalita.
Normal service
Dr. Juliana, exceptional service.
Dr. Mateus is very attentive! The reception staff are too.

The veterinary team deserves a 1000/10 rating; they saved our Amendoim's life.
They received our pet and understood our pain. With his numerous seizures, they were unparalleled in stopping the seizures and giving us the always positive emotional support that everything would be alright. Thank you so much ❤️ Especially Dr. Matheus, who gave us all the confidence about the treatment during one of the shifts.
The entire team has our admiration and affection.

I recently got health insurance for my dog, and last Saturday I took him for a routine check-up with Dr. Thais Aguiar. I was extremely satisfied; the consultation lasted an hour and included a complete medical history. All the veterinarian's instructions and guidance made me feel safe. I found her to be an excellent professional, very attentive and helpful. The receptionist was also very friendly and cordial. I loved it!

Every time I took Chico to the unit for fluid therapy (because he's a kidney patient) and tests, we were very well taken care of!
On Friday, he needed emergency care and was hospitalized, and he was very well cared for by the team. Unfortunately, due to the severity of his condition, my Chico didn't make it, but he was very well cared for in his last hours of life!
I would like to especially thank Dr. Rafaela, who was responsible for the second-to-last shift that took care of my little angel, for all the support, attention, and care she gave him, as well as for giving me extremely detailed information about his condition.
I took my dog ​​to an emergency vet and received excellent and prompt service.

I would like to register my deep dissatisfaction with the service I received at the We Vets Mooca clinic.

The first time I took my dog ​​Joey, I scheduled an appointment exclusively for vaccination. I made the appointment through the app, clearly stating that he would be vaccinated. However, upon arrival, the professional who attended to him—even though she was a veterinarian—informed me that she could not administer the vaccine and that she would need to refer the case. This was my first negative experience, as it makes no sense to schedule a vaccination appointment and leave without the procedure being performed.

In the second situation, I tried twice to have my dog ​​neutered. I emphasize that this was the third time we had all the necessary exams for neutering done, but once again, the procedure was not completed. Today, after another failed attempt, Joey returned home extremely stressed and tired. I was even informed that his tongue turned purple, as if he had been having trouble breathing. I must emphasize that Joey has never presented this type of condition before, which only confirms how completely worn out he has become in the clinic environment, further increasing my insecurity regarding the care.

Another very serious point is the total lack of communication and organization. The clinic does not provide any official landline or WhatsApp contact number for owners to monitor their animals. We are at the mercy of the staff's willingness to send a message or call from unidentified numbers, which I consider a great absurdity. Furthermore, the reception seems lost, unable to provide clear information and offering no security to the owner.

I want to highlight that I pay for the health plan directly from We Vets for my dog ​​precisely to avoid problems like these and to receive adequate care within the clinic. However, the experience has been completely frustrating, as the basics—vaccination and neutering—are not performed properly.

As a last resort, I intend to transfer the service to the Sena Madureira unit, hoping that my dog ​​can finally be neutered and receive the care I already pay for through the plan.

I hope this report is taken seriously and that measures are taken to improve the quality of service and communication with pet owners.
I would like to thank Dr. Heloísa Cristina for the excellent care she provided to my pet. I have no words to express my gratitude; she is an outstanding professional and very kind.
I visited the place and came back here to leave a review because I was warmly welcomed and assisted by Eduarda, a polite and attentive person. I will return and recommend it to close friends!

The service is unbelievably terrible!

This is simply a warning to new health plan subscribers... Do not sign up for an annual plan; they offer no refunds in cases of withdrawal or cancellation, completely disregarding the Consumer Protection Code. Your contract says nothing about information regarding the annual plan, and when needed, they refuse to comply with the law.

I would like to thank the receptionist Eduarda for her service at the Mooca unit.

Extremely polite and attentive. Congratulations on your excellence!

Regarding the service, the veterinarian Dr. Matheus Spironelli was very polite, attentive, and careful. Congratulations on your excellence!
Attentive staff, from the cleaning and reception staff to the veterinarians.

Grotesque and extremely dangerous, if not fatal, error in Myke's kidney urea test

Myke, a 15-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, was admitted to the hospital on May 17, 2025, presenting with weakness, anemia, and lack of appetite. In all consultations and conversations, it was always emphasized that Myke is a renal patient. The blood test performed on May 17, 2025, showed a urea result of 23.5mg, which is acceptable for the canine average. However, Myke is a renal patient, and we found this strange and pointed it out, but the professionals said it was impossible for the result to be wrong and that they would continue evaluating, looking for the causes of Myke's decline, increased anemia, among other results that were decreasing, and Myke's condition worsening. Today May 20, 2025, morning session. Myke was much more debilitated. The nephrologist requested a repeat of the test, which showed an error in the initial test that presented 20mg of urea. Today, the true result was 757.9 mg of urea, that is, 4 times above the maximum critical level (200mg). Myke is in a state of severe anemia and acute kidney failure (vital organ) with no reversal.

Speechless at the outcome...

According to Article 20, §2, of the Consumer Protection Code, the amount paid for a service not rendered must be refunded immediately. There is a lack of professionalism, respect for the client, and speed in resolving problems – something essential in any health service, especially veterinary care. I expected much more from a company that claims to be a partner of animal health plans.

The receptionists even tried to get me to come back another day... even though the series of errors were not my fault. I recommend it for its structure and number of exams, and they accept pet insurance... but the organization and friendliness leave something to be desired.

February 25th: We returned to have exams done. We had an appointment at 9:00 AM. We arrived early. And there was a 50-minute delay for a simple blood test.
Fantastic service at reception and from the doctors.

From the first day we arrived with Thor, we were very well taken care of. Dr. Juliana was very caring and affectionate with our little goldfish. He was being seen by several veterinarians and another hospital, visibly worsening, and we were only giving him medication.

Since Thor was having shortness of breath and couldn't walk properly anymore, we decided to go to another hospital and went to We Vets Móoca (at this point his breathing was very strange indeed). I went out of a sense of duty since he was seeing several professionals and undergoing many tests.

We did the requested tests, and with each test (there weren't many), they explained what was needed, why it was needed, and if we authorized it. Unfortunately, he had such a large tumor that it had already pushed his heart out of place... (Add to that fluid in his chest; about 5 liters were removed). Believe me, we saw both the bucket of fluid and his improvement. But this fluid was already accumulating again.

The doctors... They called us in, showed us the test results, and explained everything our eyes had already been seeing these past few days.

They could have ordered as many tests as they wanted; we would have done them all. But they left all the possibilities up to us to decide.

I felt it wasn't just about money, it was about understanding the pain of others. We were welcomed, Thor was welcomed, and that's the most important thing. Immense gratitude for the professionalism and care of this hospital and this unit.

My conclusion:
They are professionals;
They care, a lot;
They don't do unnecessary tests or procedures (believe me, we've been through this);
They don't charge exorbitant prices.

I recommend them 1000 times over.
Thank you.

I've needed to use Wevets a few times and have always received excellent service. Especially at reception (from the two Letícias), Dr. Matheus and Dr. Lucas. They make a point of explaining everything, keeping the pet owners informed about the entire situation and possibilities, always with great care and empathy. I highly recommend them for routine checkups and even emergencies.

The experience with the professional who performed the ultrasound was excellent, however, when scheduling, they informed me of a 7:50 PM appointment, but upon arrival it was 8:00 PM in order to charge an extra R$107.00 for an exam that was quoted at R$267.00! I feel like they are taking advantage of the situation; if they had informed me that it would cost this extra amount, I would have scheduled it for daytime, since it's an elective exam!
They always provide quick service and have several specialists. I really like it because they do many tests and prescribe medication right away.
I always take my pets to WeVets Mooca. All the veterinarians and assistants are lovely and truly love animals! Excellent.

Unfortunately, my cat didn't leave the hospital alive, not due to a lack of professionalism, but because of some unfortunate illness that we still don't know what it was, neither I nor the veterinarians. She arrived with a serious case of fluid in her lungs, and the extraction revealed pus, meaning an infectious process. On the last day, she had a respiratory arrest and her heart stopped.
We still don't understand why, as she wasn't a cat that went outside or didn't eat; in short, my girl was unlucky.

What upset me about the clinic were two things:
1 - To this day, I haven't received a report from the hospital about my cat's death and possible causes of what afflicted her.

2 - On the day I left with Chiara's body, the receptionist charged me for another hospitalization, even though I had already paid the day before, and it wasn't due until 9 pm, and she died around 11:15 am. Since I was covered by the Petlov plan, she didn't bother to check if I had at least paid for the request for another day of hospitalization. Furthermore, before Chiara passed away, she was going to have 2 procedures that I had already paid for, even though they weren't covered by the plan. She died without having the tests done, and I still haven't received any support from the clinic. In fact, they just say they are checking and nothing happens.

I also requested a compilation of all the tests she had done since she was hospitalized, and I haven't received it.

Finally, I would like to make it clear that the veterinarians are excellent and the staff are indeed very attentive.
